question: At the same data size, can repeating only the classifier(s) autonomously selected by the expanded entry reduce variance in categorical boosting and randomized forests? Earlier inference-reuse experiments instead added smaller-training-set fold replicas.
eligibility: The selected recurring-context/alignment tree wrappers support changing their CatBoost random_seed without changing their fit/transform protocol. A chosen scikit-learn pipeline whose final estimator exposes random_state can be cloned and that final random_state changed, leaving earlier preprocessing parameters as selected. Frozen foundation models stay exactly as fitted. No method choice is supplied. Seeds 13291 and 94723 are fixed identically across tasks and methods; the original trained member supplies the third prediction. All members keep their original equal vote.
feedback: Use the five existing 48-cap expanded ordinary training-only solves and their exact immutable training and query packets. For each selected supported member actually fit both alternative seeds from scratch on every available original assessment fold using unchanged fitting rows, feature generation, labels and hyperparameters. Average the three models within that member. Automatically adopt the repeated-seed solution only if all three matched folds are present, at least two do not lose accuracy, worst loss is no more than .003, pooled gain is at least .001, and pooled log loss does not worsen. Freeze that choice before producing outside-fold predictions. Also compute a predeclared always-average diagnostic by fitting the same two new seeds on the full fitting set. Count every fit for both decision and diagnostic, including any interrupted work.
gate: Seal all five folds before comparative scoring. The decision policy must beat both the ordinary expanded entry and same-budget teammate control by at least .003 over 8,117 external rows, show positive gains on at least three folds vs the expanded entry, and drop by no more than .004 on any fold against it. An unconditional diagnostic cannot qualify the decision policy. If positive, integrate in a fresh equal-total-budget ordinary run. The 48 cap is the previous base run, not a claim the present study used only 48 fits across all folds. Maximum 64 total fits per simulated per-task path including its original run. No paid model calls or course holdout.
